title: Provider error
description: A failure of a provider call, normalised by the adapter (additive plan sections 13 and 15.1: malformed and error mapping). kind is the provider-neutral failure; code is the platform error code it maps to (a fixed table, see the allOf: authentication_failed is unauthenticated, rate_limited is rate_limited, connection_lost is uncertain_outcome and so on); retryable follows the platform rule that only unavailable, degraded, timeout, rate_limited and resource_exhausted are retryable. A provider error never carries a response body, headers, a request, a prompt or a credential: the object is closed and message is a short fixed text written by the adapter, so a provider cannot smuggle text or a secret into an error. outcome_uncertain is true exactly for connection_lost and timeout, where the request may have reached the provider: the caller marks the outcome uncertain and never retries something that could duplicate a commit. An error never selects an alternate provider by itself: fallback happens only when policy names one and is recorded. Every member is assembled by the adapter and the core.

provider.description: The exact provider, model and version of the call.

code.description: The platform error code the kind maps to.

retryable.description: True only when re-sending the identical request unchanged, after a delay, can reasonably produce a different outcome. Follows code.

message.description: A short fixed description written by the adapter. Never a quotation of the provider response.

status.description: The HTTP status the provider returned, or null when there was no response.

retry_after_ms.description: How long the provider asked the caller to wait, in milliseconds, or null. Present only on a retryable error.

outcome_uncertain.description: True when the request may have reached the provider and had an effect. Exactly for connection_lost and timeout.

attempts.description: How many attempts were made including the first; bounded by the profile retry policy and at most 11.

provider_request_id.description: The provider correlation ID for support, or null. A provider-assigned identifier only.

allOf.description: kind authentication_failed maps to the error code unauthenticated.
kind permission_denied maps to the error code permission_denied.
kind rate_limited maps to the error code rate_limited.
kind quota_exceeded maps to the error code resource_exhausted.
kind timeout maps to the error code timeout.
kind unavailable maps to the error code unavailable.
kind bad_request maps to the error code schema_invalid.
kind context_too_large maps to the error code validation_failed.
kind content_filtered maps to the error code validation_failed.
kind unsupported_modality maps to the error code validation_failed.
kind model_not_found maps to the error code validation_failed.
kind malformed_response maps to the error code schema_invalid.
kind connection_lost maps to the error code uncertain_outcome.
kind internal maps to the error code internal.
Retryable follows the platform rule: only unavailable, degraded, timeout, rate_limited and resource_exhausted are retryable.
The outcome is uncertain exactly when the request may have reached the provider: connection_lost and timeout.
